event: 2025 ILCA Senior Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
Melker Ahlquist (Rule 42 observer) attended the hearing as an observer.
Alexander Schlonski (Coach of GER 191899) attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: Wind speed about 8 kn. and small chop.
GER 191899 and GRE 203690 were sailing on starboard tack below the starting line near the RC signal vessel at 50 sec to the starting signal.
GER 191899 heading was head to wind at that moment, and she was overlapped to leeward of GRE 203690, who was sailing on a close-hauled course.
There was another boat to leeward and overlapped with GER 191899 at a lateral distance of less than a boatwidth.
When the lateral distance between GER 191899 and GRE 203690 was 1.5 boatwidth GER hailed GRE 203690.
10 sec later a contact occurred between the starboard first 3rd of GER 191899 and the port first 3rd of GRE 203690.
No penalty taken. Rules Applicable: RRS 11, 14, N1.4(b) and Case 107
conclusions: GRE 203690 to windward failed to keep clear of GER 191899 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
GRE 203690 did not avoid contact with GER 191899 even though it was reasonably possible, and broke RRS 14(a).
It was not reasonably possible for GER 191899 the right-of-way boat to avoid contact with GRE 203690 when it became clear that GRE 203690 was not keeping clear. GER 191899 did not break RRS 14(a).
decision: GRE 203690 is DSQ in race nr. 7
